lore:
# The Zenith of Arcana: Wish

To cast *Wish* is to seize the very loom of creation. It is the ultimate audacity—the mortal voice commanding the universe to rewrite its laws.

### The Manifestation
When the final syllable is uttered, reality does not merely change; it shudders. The atmosphere fractures into prismatic shards, and for a fleeting heartbeat, the world ripples like a reflection in a disturbed pond. A blinding, golden singularity erupts from the caster’s heart, stitching the impossible into the fabric of the "now."

### The Sensation
One does not simply channel the Weave; one is nearly unmade by it. It feels like molten starlight rushing through the marrow, a weight so immense it threatens to unravel the caster’s soul. To shape this magic is to stand at the precipice of godhood, feeling the terrifying elasticity of existence.

### The Legend
Sages trace its discovery to *Aethelgard the Dreamer*, a hermit who sat in silence for forty years. It is said he finally spoke a single word—not of any known tongue, but the primal vibration of the First Spark—and in doing so, turned a scorched wasteland into a sea of lilies.
